methodology: Serial matched searches on the same 24 public positions, warming all backends. Two backends use AB/BA; three backends rotate order by position and reverse it on the second repetition. Fixed work validates full reports and latency; timed work measures samples completed in equal soft deadlines. No CPU profiler during measurements.
limitations: A deterministic representative position suite is not a playing-strength test. Timed counts fluctuate with scheduling and evolving tree costs; raw rows retained. Prior tournament/replay outputs and frozen baseline are unchanged.
